headline: Elementary Set Operations on Population U

items.title: Set and Subset
items.detail: Circle A inside rectangle U: a well-defined collection and proper subset A ⊂ U.

items.title: Union and Intersection
items.detail: A ∪ B joins members; A ∩ B keeps only shared members.

items.title: Disjoint Union
items.detail: When A ∩ B = ∅, the join is a partition written A ∪̇ B.

items.title: Plain-Language Symbols
items.detail: Every operator on screen maps to spoken definitions before Equations 2.1–2.4.
